text:
sara: Quick follow-up from the postmortemKV cache OOM. I split actions into immediate, experiments, and guardrails. Ack or reassign by EOD. Running a 48h rapid loop.

mike: ackI'll own lightweight heap sampling and exports. Plan: 10m probe every 4h, cap CPU to 5%. Artifacts -> s3.

mike: sampler cron:
```
0 */4 * * * /usr/local/bin/heap-sampler --scope=kv --dur=600 --limit-cpu=5% --out=s3://redwood-telemetry/heap-samples/2965432100/
```
Note: ~3-5% CPU on p3-small, will schedule outside peak jobs.

anisha: I'll run slab/eviction experiments and a small GC compact test. Matrix: slab_target=[0.5,0.6], eviction=[lru,hybrid], compact=true/false. Reporting slab_frag_ratio + avg_rss.

ben: infra will spin a matching staging mirror. ETA 2h. Canary plan: 10% traffic, 15m window, RB on >5% RSS delta or error spike. PR coming.

elaine: drafting follow-up digest template: fields run_id, peak_rss, slab_frag_ratio, top_alloc_sites, repro_steps, PRs, owner, status. First digest 08:00 UTC tomorrow.

jules: repro steps: hit /v1/stream with context-size=32k, 6 concurrent streams, observe RSS rise after ~5-8m.

ben: PR #501 pushed with softlimit defaults:
```
softlimit_rss: 9G
kv_softlimit_pct: 78
oom_guard_delay_ms: 250
```
Canary scheduled when staging ready.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled for staging at 2026-05-15T09:00:00Z. Auto-rollback enabled.

mike: first sample uploaded s3://redwood-telemetry/heap-samples/2965432100/run-001.json (snippet in digest).

anisha: if slab tuning not effective, prototype allocator change to free pinned pages sooner; ETA prototype 4d.

sara: action owners (48h unless reassigned): mike: sampler + parser; anisha: experiments; ben: infra & canary; elaine: digest; dev owners: paste repros.

sara: added OOM watch 08:15 UTC daily for week. We'll convert winning mitigation to platform guardrail after confirmation. :thumbsup:
